events.t: FCC import ban on Chinese optical transceivers (drafting)
events.why: Chinese vendors hold >50% of the global datacenter-transceiver market, InnoLight alone ~27% (Counterpoint). A US import ban on new models would forcibly re-route that demand to COHR, LITE, AAOI, FN, CIEN, NOK, MTSI, SMTC — but the Foundation for American Innovation notes the Western vendors lack the SCALE to replace Chinese supply quickly, so the near-term effect is pricing power and shortage, not clean substitution. Mirror-image risk for 300308.SZ and 300502.SZ. Still drafting — could be modified or shelved.
